dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, closed-loop 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast silvery-white perimeters. The edges exhibit a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity exterior borders to low-intensity, dark-colored interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated at the vertices where multiple macro-annuli intersect, as well as isolated punctate marks in the anterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most prominent macro-annuli on the dorsal surface form an irregular, elongated pentagonal relationship with acute angles directed toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A transition zone in the anterior region where discrete macro-annuli merge into a highly dense, chaotic reticulated mesh of fine high-contrast lines.
